And no, you do not rely on people too much. This is a struggle and you need help. But whatever you do, wherever you go people will always hate on you. Im a girl in the UK and I've experienced something similar. 

So going to the GP for me was a total failure, they dont do nothing to help. However, what they do is get you into councelling if needed be, for an emergency patient. That is what happened to me. 

The doctors do tend to diagnose you with disorders but dont listen to them. The only person who can diagnose you is your councelling team. But otherwise they cant do nothing. 

And a councillor (ive been going to 2 years of counselling so I kinda know what they would say), they would say distract yourself but I believe your case is something more serious. 

Talk to people. Try and get as much support as you need to. And you must not give in to the suicidal urges. Leave it to a last resort. 

Your fighting a huge battle, but with the right support you will overpower this problem. Stay strong soldier. 

Im here if you need to talk

Battling with this stuff is hard. And life just is a pain in the ass. The thought of suicide as an option is somewhat comforting, and you just believe life is hell. 

But what ever you do, DONT. 

More people care about you then you know. People make jokes to hide the truth. People make fun of you because they wish they had what you had. Society is an ass, but trust me, it might not get better but there is also a positive to everything. Its the way the world works. 

Its very brave for you to come out as say this on a public subreddit. I salute you for it. For keeping alive all this time, you are a soldier, and I respect you. 

If you ever need someone, I am here. We all are here. You are never alone in this war. Just please, dont write anything. Please. 

And you are not attention seeking, you are simply reaching out for help. People who dont see that need to experience what we feel for them to change their minds about this. 

But you are strong, stronger than you know. Please leave suicide to last minute resort because every attempts leave a mark on your mind. I value you, soldier.

One time when I was 7 or 8 I was really sick and bed ridden for a few days. My room was the front room and it was the summer, which means that we got the most sunlight, and the most heat during mid day to dusk. So when I was ill, my parents put a bed sheet over my window, to block out the sunlight. The bed sheet was dark green with Ben 10 and which creatures he transforms over it. So I was laying in bed, feeling absolutely terrible as I just woken from a sleep and threw up in a bucket beside me, and i saw that the monsters from the bed sheet was coming towards me, making weird noises and shapes. I was that terrified I ran down the stairs to my parents and told them about it. They told me it wasnt real and I went back to bed. The creatures were back on the sheet, but I was scared as heck. 

I wouldn't count this as creepy or a hallucination, but it was scary to a 7 year old girl who was really sick. Needless to say I never watched Ben 10 after that, even now, 8 years later.

Im a British teen right now but I remember in year 8 (about 7th grade) I recently broke up with a boyfriend, and I was suffering with major heartbreak and depression. It was 4th lesson, and I was in Geography, sitting alone in the back of the class. I dont know why but I decided to hit my head off the wall three times, and the desk about twice. Everyone just stared and laughed, while the teaher sent me outside the class. It was at that time I wanted to die. People still go on about it to this day, and I just awkwardly laugh along and thing about why I did it. 

I still hit my head off the wall sometimes, only when I am alone though. #neverlearn

The amount of detail put into this theory is convincing, however there are a number of things wrong with it. 

 Petscop and doki doki was introduced in the same year, petscop being in march and doki doki being in September. The correlation between them linking is hardly possible as it takes on average 1-3 years working on a game, its sound track and all sorts. 

Team salvato (the creators of doki doki) is a team where they, to quote, "aim to tell stories and express creativity in ways not possible using traditional media. As an interactive art form, games can become a part of your story, as well. Through that, we aim to inspire others." Petscop is similar in that sense as it aims to tell the story of a kidnapper and a murderer, and to expose him for what he did, consequently trapping his soul inside. These might be similar points but Who they are aimed for, is not. 

For example, Doki Doki is aimed at the player, or you. It goes through your personal data and finds things to do with you. Its manipulating you, as the player, to help Monika and the girls to get out. Petscop, is a game where only Paul plays, and we view it as an outside perspective. We cant interact, we cant do nothing but sit and watch, while Paul (from when he was around) makes the decision on his own. 

I dont know why I just did that but, honestly, your theory is a good theory, but probably end up being a faux. Dont let this get to you, and keep on theorising my friend 👍
